podcast.body: This album was released in 2003 by The Network on the indie label Adeline Records, which is owned by Green Day's Billie Joe Armstrong. Although Billie Joe Armstrong has denied any connection, it is widely suspected that all three members of Green Day are involved, with evidence including lyrical biographical references to Armstrong and the band's website registration to Green Day Inc. "In 2003, an indie label based out of the Bay Area of California issued an album called Money Money 2020 by a group called The Network."
